title: The Coming of Sayyidina `Isa (a)
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Dastoor yaa RijaalAllah. Bismillah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi 'l-Aleeyu
'l-Azheem. Yaa Sayyidee, madad. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah.
La ilaaha illa-Llah, Sayyidina Muhammadun Rasoolullah `alayhi salaatullah wa 's-salaam. Dastoor yaa

RijaalAllah, dastoor yaa Sultanu 'l-Awliya, dastoor. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Our Master! Master of this world, master of this planet, even it is too big for us, but really our planet is like a
small atom, dharrah. We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, that we are asking
protection from Allah Almighty against Shaytan's tricks and traps and not to fall in it. Who is falling in it, it is
difficult to save himself or herself. Therefore, beware not to fall or not to be caught by Shaytan's trap.
O our Lord! We are weak servants. We are running to You and we are saying, bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'rRaheem. Don't forget to say, bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, because whoever is saying that holy word, is
going to be under Divinely protection.
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum, servants of the Lord of Heavens, servants of whole Creator that is creating
everything. O People! As-salaamu `alaykum. Come and listen. We don't know when our life is going to end,
anytime. You may live for a hundred years or maybe your life is going to be as long as the life of Sayyidina

Nuh (a), one-thousand years or more and it just passed so quickly. Allah, Allah. And he had been asked, "O
Nuh, what is your 'intibah, reflection about such a long time?" Only he was calling his people for 950 years,
calling them to believe about their Creator, and before and after that, how long he was living, Allah knows.
Just he has been asked, "What is your thinking about such a long life?" He was saying, "O People! I am going
to say to you what is that long life through my eyes. I am looking and saying that I am such a person just
entered from one gate of a big building and I am walking, walking, walking. Now I find another gate, I am
just leaving this and coming to two doors of an entrance. Just I entered yesterday and today I am leaving.
That is my `intibah, that I may say to you."
What do you think the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (pbuh) was saying? He was saying, "Lives of
the people of my nation going to be so short, between 60 or 70 years." Mostly they are living to reach only 60
or 70 years, in some exceptions they are passing that limit, but commonly their lives going to be between 60
years and 70 years. And people now, all of them just cheated. The biggest cheater, Shaytan, is saying to them,
"O people, you have long years. Your life is long. Try to enjoy yourself. Don't listen to anyone else. You must
try to take enjoyment and pleasure through this short period of your life. Now you are on your horse, whip
your horse to run, to enjoy. To where? Run to let no one to reach to you." That is Shaytan's deceiving people,
saying, "Don't worry! Long life yet for you." That is the source of every trouble because now people are only
running to reach more naseeb, chance to reach more from dunya. That is their first aim. "We must try to
reach more and more from dunya so we may be so happy from our dunya." And Shaytan whipping them,
saying, "Run, run, more and more," until no one can live like Sayyidinna Nuh (a), one-thousand years. So
people are just cheated because they are really drunk.
O Salafi `ulamas! Marhabam! What was Sayyidina `Ali karamullaha wajahu saying? We are respecting
Sayyidina Ali (q) more than anyone else. We love him and respect him because he was following the Seal of
Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana stands and sits.) Allah, Allah. He was saying... I dont' know if
you read it or saying, "We are not taking care." No! You must take care. No one can object on the declaration
of Sayyidina Rasoolullah (s):
•••••• •••••••• •••••• ••••••• •••••••
Ashaabika 'n-nujoom bi ayyihim iqtadaytum, ihtadaytum, "My Companions are like stars. Whichever of them
you use as a guide, you will be rightly guided."

What are you understanding, Salafi `ulamas, say!! What Prophet (s) saying, Ashaabika 'n-nujoom, is it true
or not? Yes, it is true.
I am asking now our Shi'a brothers that they are not accepting Sayyidina Abu Bakr (r) or Sayyidina `Umar
(r), even Sayyidina `Uthman (r); only they are saying Sayyidina 'Ali (q). I am asking what are they
understanding from Prophet's hadeeth, Ashaabika 'n-nujoom. It is something we are writing through books.
Salafi `ulamas, why are you not saying this to these people? Say to them! Don't hide Prophet's (s) words! It is
written in the Holy Qur'an:
••••••••••• ••••••••••••• •••• •••••••••••
wa bin najmihum yahtadoon
And by the stars they (Mankind) guide themselves. (16:16)
Which najm? Who is najm? What do you think about najm? I am asking through east and west, everyone,
what are you understanding from the Holy Qu'ran, bin naj'ami? Alif-laam fee with najm. Najm, is for whole
najoom, but you must not think that what Prophet (s) saying, what the Holy Qur'an saying, wa bin najmihum
yahtadoon, but what Allah Almighty (swt) is asking people to understand.
The Seal of Prophets (s) was speaking and giving meanings of the Holy Qur'an. The whole Sahaaba and
`ulamas were taking commentary of the Holy Qur'an from the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Rasoolullah (s).
Tafseer of wa bin najmuhum yahtadoon bin najm, commentary Rasoolullah (s) bringing. He was saying,
"Ashaabika 'n-nujoom, maqsood. The real meaning the Lord of Heavens giving us through the Holy Qur'an,
saying, 'O My beloved one, your companions, each one of them, they are like najm, star. Bi ayyihim
iqtadaytum ihtadaytum. Any one of them, you can follow him, making you to reach ridwaanAllah, Allah
Almighty's pleasure.' He shall be pleased with you if anyone following one Sahaba."
I am asking you, Sayyidina Abu Bakr (r) was not Sahaba? Sayyidina `Umar (r) was not Sahaba? What did
they do wrong that so many million people are swearing and not giving their highest respect to them. There is
something true, something wrong. Two ways always. True way what Prophet (s) saying, wrong way what
Shaytan showing. I am asking forgiveness for me, for whole people. If you are doing something wrong,
maghfirat, to be forgiven. We must follow the Holy Qur'an.

O Muslim world! You must follow the Holy Qur'an and the Seal of Prophets (s) was saying, "My nation going
to come through 73 different groups. Only one of them is on right path. They will be saved. And 72 groups
going on wrong way, taking people to Hells." Time is over that the Seal of Prophets (s) is giving good tidings
that when the Last Days of this world approaching, Allah Almighty (swt) is going to send one imaam. That
Prophet (s) saying al-Mahdi'u minna, Sayyidina Imaam Mahdi (a) is on the way of the Seal of Prophets (s).
The Seal of Prophets (s) was saying that, "When the Last Days approaching, Allah Almighty sending to my
nation to make clear right way and wrong way."
Now as much as `ulama saying this and saying that, but no power. Power going to be with Imam Mahdi (a).
He is coming to correct every wrong action, every wrong thinking, every wrong practicing, yes. We are
believing in the Holy Qur'an and are believing that the whole ahadeeth of Rasool (s) are holy,
••••• ••••••• •••• ••••••••
wa maa yantiqu `ani 'l-hawaa
he does not speak from his own desire. (An-Najm, 53:3)
The Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands) what he is saying is Haqq.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.) He is going to correct his nation's beliefs and actions. Therefore, he is not coming but
sending someone from his holy family, Ahlu 'l-Bayt, to correct every wrong thing on this Earth, and this
world must be corrected.
Now people, no one accepting truth or true ones or true people! They are saying, "We know, and this is our
beliefs." You may be patient until Sayyidina Mahdi (a) comes and saying to you what is happening. Perhaps
so many thousands of people will say, "You are not Mahdi." But Mahdi's (s) sword reaching from east to west
as Christians saying that Jesus Christ (a), "He is coming." It is one of the big signs of al-Qiyamah, Last Days.
And he is not coming on a church; he is coming from heavens down but he is not going to land on Rome or a
church or a Constantinople church or a Damascus church, no. He is coming from the heavens and landing on
the minaret of the Ummawiyyah Mosque in Damascus. Prophet (s) will inform that Jesus Christ (a) is coming
from heavens and coming from sharqi minara, east direction minaret. Alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah. Any
group can't say that Jesus Christ (a) is coming through Switzerland or through Paris or through Rome or
through Moscow or through east and west, no. He is coming though the holy land of Damascus.

You know such things, O our friends? Never speaking. You are Salafi `ulamas, why are you not making clear
for Christians to say that Jesus Christ (a) is not coming to Rome or to Constantinople or to Egypt? No, but
coming to Damascus. Why are you not saying, Salafi `ulamas? Why are you hiding such an important point
that showing the glory of Islam? And Jesus Christ (a) coming on famous minaret through Damascus, Sham.
He is coming.
First of all, Christians saying, "We are not accepting a person coming and landing on a minaret." In spite of
their will he is coming, and when looking and seeing that he is crowned with the turban of Islam, they are
saying, "We are not accepting. This is not Jesus Christ." O Salafi `ulama what are you saying when Jesus
Christ coming like this (Sheikh removes all head covering)? Or like this (Sheikh puts on kufi)? Or coming like
this (Sheikh puts scarf over kufi)? How coming? Or is he coming with taaj al-Islam, crown of Islam (Sheikh
places turban on his head)? Why are you not saying? Why are you not using crown of Islam, taaj al-Arab?
Why are you not saying? Why are you not using? What is your reason? Allah (swt) will ask you why you are
keeping such realities and not saying. For dunya? `ala 'd-dunya kha raa. WC (bathroom), center of dunya.
Therefore, I am speaking a very gentle word for understanding for Salafi people; always they are asking a very
gentle word, therefore I said.
He is coming. Christians asking, "How?" Christians saying, "That is Jesus Christ." His hair, nothing on his
head. Why always pope, bishops, cardinals, or other priests are using such a thing on their head if Jesus
Christ (a) not putting anything on his head? Then take off and throw away and go without anything on your
heads! Jesus Christ (a) coming with covering of holy people, because only holy people can use this crown of
Islam, as well as whole nation. You must understand.
Yes? Sometimes I know something and I don't know nothing, but it is coming to me.
O Salafi `ulamas! So many things you have a responsibility for and you are not keeping that responsibility
and you are not saying to ummah, keeping or hiding. I am nothing. I am not taking any salary. Therefore, if
you are fearing for your salary and positions, high jobs, you will say in Divinely Presence why you are not
carrying swords! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Keep yourselves on the Right Path. Who is going on the Right Path will be saved here and

Hereafter. Those whom are going and leaving Right Path, heavenly anger will be punishing them. Hear from
your Lord, Salafi `ulamas! You must also be ashamed in front of the Seal of Prophets (s)!
O People! Listen and obey. Listen once again, once again, until real Muslims and their real identities may be
seen and may be known. What we are saying was what Sayyidina `Ali (q) was saying, an naasu niyaamun fa
idhaa maatoo 'ntabahoo, "People are sleeping, (and when they die they awaken)." Not only sleeping but
people are drunk. From what? Shaytan making them to drink and making them to be drunk. Drunk Muslim
world can't do anything. Therefore, we are asking from Allah Almighty to send to us a sultan who is never
fearing from whole nations, his only fear is from his Lord Almighty!
May Allah forgives us.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah
••••• •••• •••• ••••• •••••••
an-naasu niyaamun fa idhaa maatoo intabahoo (du`a).
Support us with heavenly armies that they are ready to make Islam up and to make every belief against Islam
down!
Fatihah.
Dome, dome, dome, dome 12x
Fatihah.
(51 minutes, 497,000)
Alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah.
(Mawlana Shaykh Hisham calls on phone. Sultan is so happy!)

Alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah yaa Rabbee, yaa Rabbee, Allah shukr!
